projects.title: Speckle Pattern Analysis Using Differential Dynamic Matrix
projects.publication: Speckle pattern analysis using differential dynamic matrix
projects.question: How can speckle analysis resolve evolving paint-drying dynamics at different spatial and temporal scales?
projects.abstract: We extended differential dynamic microscopy to laser speckle patterns, quantifying time- and spatial-frequency-dependent dynamics during the drying of paint layers.
contribution: Contributed to differential-dynamic-matrix analysis of laser speckle patterns.
Investigated the evolving optical response during paint-layer drying.
Compared the dynamics of 100 and 200 µm layers across spatial scales.
projects.result: DDM-LSA resolved evolving dynamics across spatial scales without direct particle tracking. The 100 µm layer stabilized faster, while the 200 µm layer retained longer-lived activity.
projects.scope: The reported comparison concerns the paint layers and acquisition conditions shown in the publication.

groups.title: Acquisition and motion history
groups.intro: Camera-based laser speckle acquisition captures changing activity in the two paint layers.

groups.title: Dynamics across time and spatial scales
groups.intro: Lag-time curves and spatial-frequency response quantify how the measured dynamics evolve during drying.

projects.deck: Following paint-drying dynamics across spatial and temporal scales, without tracking individual particles.

projects.title: Remote Battery Evaluation by Secondary Speckle Patterns
projects.publication: Remote battery evaluation by secondary speckle patterns
projects.question: Can vibration-induced changes in a secondary speckle pattern distinguish battery states without direct electrical contact?
projects.abstract: I investigated battery states by recording vibration-induced shifts in far-field laser speckle patterns and analyzing their frequency-dependent response.
contribution: Investigated secondary-speckle responses under controlled battery vibration.
Analyzed correlation-derived pattern displacement and its frequency response.
Examined full-versus-empty discrimination and changes during NiMH discharge.
projects.result: Distinct speckle responses separated the tested full and empty batteries, while signal metrics also followed NiMH discharge.
projects.scope: Results concern the tested batteries and vibration conditions; this study does not establish a universal battery-health calibration.

groups.title: Experiment and processing

groups.title: Full and empty battery discrimination

groups.intro: Time-dependent optical metrics presented in the source portfolio.

projects.deck: Reading the response of vibrating batteries through secondary laser speckle.

projects.title: Remote Monitoring of Powder Dehumidification
projects.publication: Remote monitoring of powder dehumidification by speckle pattern analysis
projects.question: Can dynamic speckle fluctuations provide a non-contact optical signature of moisture-driven changes in powder?
projects.abstract: We used camera-recorded laser speckle to monitor drying in cornstarch powder and compared optical trends with independent surface-profilometry measurements.
contribution: Contributed to non-contact laser-speckle monitoring of powder drying.
Analyzed time-history speckle patterns during a humidity transition.
Compared optical trends with independent surface-profilometry measurements.
projects.result: The optical trends agreed with surface profilometry, supporting speckle analysis as a non-invasive way to follow the measured drying process.
projects.scope: The study presents an optical signature of the drying process; it does not claim direct, absolute moisture-content measurement.

groups.title: Speckle-derived dynamics
groups.intro: Time-history speckle matrices illustrate the evolving optical activity during dehumidification.

groups.title: Independent structural validation
groups.intro: Surface-profilometry maps provide an independent view of the structural changes during drying.

projects.deck: An optical signature of moisture-driven change in cornstarch powder.

projects.title: Laser Speckle Analysis for Remote Current Detection in Wires
projects.publication: Laser speckle analysis for remote detection of electric current flowing in wires
projects.question: Can optical speckle activity reveal DC current in an insulated wire without direct electrical contact?
projects.abstract: We investigated non-contact DC-current sensing using time-resolved laser-speckle patterns scattered from insulated wires, relating the measured optical activity to applied current.
contribution: Contributed to camera-based laser speckle measurements from insulated wires.
Investigated current-dependent speckle activity using temporal analysis.
Examined calibration responses across conductor materials and wire diameters.
projects.result: Current-dependent speckle activity enabled calibration-based estimation across the wire materials and diameters tested.
projects.scope: The reported results concern the tested insulated wires, conductor materials, and wire diameters.

groups.title: Optical experimental arrangement

groups.title: Temporal speckle analysis
groups.intro: Co-occurrence matrices and motion-history images reveal current-dependent activity.

groups.title: Quantifying the current response
groups.intro: Inertia-moment measurements compare different conductor materials and copper-wire diameters.

projects.deck: Using current-dependent speckle activity for non-contact electrical sensing.
